verdict.rationale: Translation is a fair axis for a speech-to-text API, but nothing in the pack documents a translation option or endpoint. Language coverage evidence (99 languages) is about transcription only. The speech-understanding layer lists summarization, sentiment and topic detection, not translation. LLM Gateway access to frontier models is only a developer building block someone could use to build translation, not a documented translation capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a transcript translated to another language through a documented option or endpoint
